canvas.trigger_method: Successful activation was Tools -> Canvas in a fresh chat, then sending the document prompt. The requested prompt containing 'Use Canvas mode' first produced a Google Workspace connection request instead of a Canvas artifact; no connection was made.

editor_focused_controls.observation: Clicking inside div[aria-label="Canvas editor"] moved focus into the editor. No additional inline formatting toolbar, AI edit popover, or suggestion controls appeared from focus alone.
The same Canvas top toolbar and expanded formatting toolbar controls remained visible.

canvas.notes: Canvas appeared as a right-side editor/artifact panel. Share/export options were only opened for observation and closed with Escape. No document content was intentionally modified.

deep_research.notes: Deep Research produced a plan first and required clicking Start research to begin the actual report. The Sources chooser was opened only for observation and closed without selecting Gmail, Drive, or Chat. Example observed source domains included sciencedaily.com, news.gm.com, pv-magazine.com, batterytechonline.com, carnewschina.com, electrek.co, woodmac.com, formenergy.com, and azocleantech.com.

guided_learning.notes: At 10 seconds the response was still generating and showed an 'Answer now' button plus Stop response. After waiting longer, the completed response showed a lesson, a visualization opt-in, and suggested next topics. No quiz widgets, explicit Next step/Continue buttons, progress indicators, I understand controls, comprehension check controls, or difficulty adjustment controls were visible without clicking the visualization opt-in or sending a follow-up.
